༄༅/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rlung 'khyil pa bzhugs so/ /shog 'dra'i skor/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rlung 'khyil pa bzhugs so/ /

shog 'dra'i skor/ dngos grub kun gyi rin chen gter/ /padma thod phreng rtsal la 'dud/ / gnod sbyin dmar nag sgrub pa yi/ /rim pa me rlung 'khyil ba bshad/ /'di la sgrub pa'i rim pa mang yang*/ brten na bkra shis la/ rbad na mthu che ba dril sgrub gsang ba yang gsang yin pas/ de la rten bca' ba/ bsgrub par bya ba/ las phran tshegs bstan pa gsum las/ dang po ni rang gi sgrub khang du stegs bu mda' gang 'brub khung dang bcas pa'i zur bzhir/ 'om bu'i mda' bzhi la za 'og dang*/ bya rgod kyi sgro can/ dar sna dang rin po che sna tshogs pa mgul du btag pa gzugs/ maṇḍal gyi steng gi nam mkhar 'dzin gtor spod dang zas sna dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i nang du/ 'khor dang 'byor pa spel cig /bgegs dang bar chad srungs shig /'gal byed cham la phob cig /ces pa gser gyi sa bris te gzhug /de la gnod sbyin gyi tsa ka li gzugs/ /de nyid rgyun du mi gshegs par gzhag go /'phral gtor ci rigs pa maṇḍal gyi zur du bsham mo/ /rgyun du mi 'bral ba blo rdo'i man ngag la/ dar dmar po'am shog gu la gnod sbyin gyi gzugs bris pa'i lto bar mu khyud rim pa bzhir bskor ba'i phyi ma la/ mthu ser gyi dngos grub stsol cig bris/ de'i nang ma la mi nor zas gsum si ti (< a > siddhi ) pha la ho bri/ de'i nang ma la 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad la/ e he ma ru tse dgra bgegs thams cad sha trūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa bri/ lte ba la drag po'i dngos grub dang*/ mi nor zas gsum gyi dngos grub rtsol cig bris pa'i dbus su kṣa dang*/ hrī kha sprad pa mtshal gyis gzab mar bri/ dri bzang dang sman sna byugs la/ rdo pha wang long bu'i ngos drug gi gsum la hrī gsum/ gsum la kṣa gsum bris te/ rab gnas byas nas gril te zangs khab dang bcas pa dar dmar pos gril ba la tshon skud sna lngas re re dkris te/ bya pho mtsha' lu'i snying nang du bcug pa de phyir khug tu bcug la lus la bcang ngo*/

des ni snying nye bkra shis zas nor dang 'khor 'dab 'phel/ ci bgo ba nyan/ lus dang grib ma ltar 'ong ngo*/ /gnyis pa sgrub pa ni/ sngon 'gro bdag nyid lhar gsal bas/ dngos gzhi gnod sbyin bskyed cing sngags bzlas pa/ rjes bstod bskul bya ba dang gsum las/ dang po ni rang nyid padma drag sgrub gang rung du bsgoms nas thugs sngags ci 'grub bzlas so/ /dngos gzhi ni mdun gyi bar snang la gnod sbyin dmar nag zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zangs kyi bya khyung dmar po bcibs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po ral gri/ 'og ma gri gug /g.yon dang po dgra snying dang bdud zhags/ 'og ma bhandha khrag gis bkang ba 'dzin pa/ ral pa dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ thal chen dang zhag gi tshom bu can/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhis stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pas smad dkris pa/ me'i tshwa tshwa dang thog ser 'phro ba/ gdong mo bzhi dang lha srin sde brgyad dang*/ sha za stong gis bskor bar bsams la/ tshil chen gyi dud pa btang*/ thod rnga dang rol mo dkrol nas/ bhruṃ bhyo/ sngon gyi bskal pa dang po la/ /he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du/ / bsad khrag rba klong dkyil 'khor nas/ /gnod sbyin phung byed mthu rtsal can// chibs su zangs kyi bya khyung bcibs/ /'khor du sha za stong gis bskor/ / gnod sbyin chen po sku bskyod cig /shan pa dmar nag dam la shog /e he rma ru tse ghu na hri tri/ ghraṃ bhyo sha raṃ bhyo/ phu ru dza ghri ga /ha la 'gran ta ya dzaḥdza/ zhes pa nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ lho phyogs kyi dur khrod nas/ rten bskyed pa de la thogs med du byon nas thim par bsams la/ sngags de'i mthar bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags pa bdun gyis gtor ma phul nas/ srog gi snying po bzlas pa ni/ e haṃ shaṃ tri taṃ rtsal tri ra gaṃ sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ/ nā ga rā dza kro ta ni/ tri kha thun tri la thun a bhi shu nā ga rā dza dzaḥdzaḥ/

tri kha thun bhyo/ dgra bgegs mā ra ya rbad/ ces ci 'grub bzlas rjes bstod bskul bya ba ni/ gtor ma sngar bzhin phul la rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pas 'di skad do/ /e he rma ru tse bhyo/ gling bzhi srid pa'i pho brang nas/ phung byed dmar nag gshegs su gsol/ /slob dpon padma'i spyan snga ru/ /bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /gnod sbyin chen po gshegs su gsol/ /phyag dang zhabs gnyis bsil mdzad la/ /padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /dwangs ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /'gal 'khrul nyams chag thams cad bshags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /dgyes pa'i zhal bzang dus 'dir ston/ /bcol pa'i las rnams 'grub par mdzod/ /ces mchod bstod bya'o/ /de ltar zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig mtshams bcad de bsgrubs pas/ dngos sam rmi lam du rol mo'i sgra dang*/ 'od dang skye bo mang po 'du ba dang*/ dpon skya dang*/ zhang blon dang*/ dge bshes dang*/ ban bon gyi tshogs rnams bdag la 'dud pa dang*/ nor dang 'bru'i gter rnyed pa ni 'grub pa'i rtags so/ /sngon du sgrub pa'i las 'di kho na gal che'o/ /phyis nas gang 'dod pa 'grub pa yin pas sgrub pa la 'bad par bya'o/ /gsum pa las phran tshegs sgrub pa la/ dgra bsad pa dang*/ ngag mnan pa dang*/ ser ba dbab pa dang*/ cho 'phrul gtong ba dang*/ sri'u gso ba/ nor sgrub pa dang drug las/ dang po bsad pa ni/ brag dmar gyi phug pa la sogs par/ sa stegs mda' gang gru gsum pa ro sol gyis byugs par/ dgra bo'i ling ga bris te/ dzas mtha' bskor nas/ dgug gzhug bya ste/ khyi thod lcags kyi 'khor khang du bsams par bcug nas/ bdag dang gnod sbyin gyi sgom bzlas sngar dang 'dra ba las/ sngags ni/ e he rma ru tse/ ghu na hrī tri/ bhraṃ bhyo/ sha raṃ bhyo/ phu ru dza ghrig /ha la 'gran ta ya/ gyin ta rbad sod/

su ru snying tse/ a pa laṃ che ge mo mā ra ya sod/ ra rgyug srog la rgyug /sha la rngam/ dbugs la rngubs/ khrag la 'jibs/ tsig tsig srog la yaṃ yaṃ/ zhes bzlas nas/ bstod ba'i rjes la/ gnod sbyin chen po ma rungs pa/ /sha za khrag 'thung stong gis bskor/ / lha srin sdai brgyad dmag dpung bcas/ /dgra bo'i steng du da rgyug cig /rbad kyang phrin las mi byed na/ /dam tshig nyams par mi 'gyur ram/ /da dung dgra bo mi gsod na/ /gnod sbyin khyod la ci byung gi /da lta nyid du sod la shog /sha zo khrag 'thung snying rtsa phyung*/ /bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog /ces rbad la/ bsad sngags de lcags phye zangs phye rdo phyai nyung nag dug sna'i thun dang bsdebs la/ ling ga brab pas/ rdul phran du song bar bsam mo/ /de ltar zhag bdun bsgrubs pas rmi lam du don snying 'byin pa dang*/ lings byed pa dang*/ shing gcod pa la sogs pa rmis dus grub pas/ /ling ga mtshon gyis gtubs la me nang du gnod sbyin bskyod pa'i zhal du phul nas thal ba lam rgya gram gyi 'og tu mnan pas/ las zla ba mi 'gyangs bar 'grub bo/ /de ltar byas kyang ma grub na/ /gnad la dbab pa ni/ gnod sbyin gyi gzugs srog sngags dang bcas pa bris te/ dgug gzhug byas nas/ te lo 'am/ phag thod du bcug la/ rang gi mal 'og tu dong gru gsum brus pa'i nang ro sol byugs/ ro thal bting nas thod pa de gzhag /sa tshon sna lngas steng g.yogs/ rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i g.yam pas kha bcad la/ dong lcags khang du bsams pas gnod sbyin bka' nyan par bsam zhing*/ rang nyid lhar gsal bas drag sngags bzlas pas/ dgra rtags byung ba dang*/ thod pa phyung la sku bton te 'o mas bkrus la bzod par gsol te/ las sbyor byas pas 'grub bo/ /des kyang ma grub na/ sngags kyi sgrom bya ba ni/ āoṃ ka kha ga gha nga*/ he bhyo rma ru tse ghu na hrī tri tsitta hring hring dza/

zhes bzlas pas rtags byung ba dang*/ e he rma ru tse ghu na hrī tri/ ghraṃ bhyo shaṃ raṃ bhyo/ phu ru dza ghrig hal pa 'gran ta yā/ gyin ta rbad sod/ su ru snying tse/ a pa laṃ mā ra ya sod/ sarba sha trūṃ che ge mo mār ya rbad/ ces sngar gyi bsad sngags kyis brab la/ srog gnon gyi las byas pas mi 'grub mi srid do/ /ngag gnon ni dug shog la dgra'i ling ga lce lto bar drangs pa'i dbus su rdo rje rgya gram bris pa'i rwa bzhi la/ āoṃ nan/ ā nan/ hūṃ nan/ st+waṃ bha ya nan/ lte bar nṛ bri/ lce'i tha mar che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum st+waṃ bha ya nan bris te/ dug khrag gis byugs la dgug bzhugs byas la/ skud pa phyir bkal gyi tshon skud kyis dkris te/ khyi thod dam lkugs pa'i thod par bcug la/ dug sna dang*/ nyung nag gi thun gyis brab cing*/ rtsa sngags kyi sham du/ āoṃ laṃ nṛ dza/ dgra bo che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum st+waṃ bha ya nan/ a laṃ nṛ dza hūṃ laṃ nṛ dza/ nā ga sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzlas te/ nyin mo thun gyis brab/ mtshan mo rang gi mal 'og tu dong gru gsum brus par bcug nas ro g.yam gyis kha bcad la zhag gsum bsgrub nas/ ling ga mal 'og nas phyung ste tshwa tshwa nag po'i zhabs su bcug nas lha khang rnyings pa'i them 'og tu mnan pas/ dgra'i nus pa nyams/ ngag lkugs kho rang gi byad kha kho rang la log nas brlag par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni sngags pa nang 'gras na bya'o/ /ser ba dbab pa ni/ 'brub khung gru gsum du/ ro sol dang*/ thal chen byugs la/ ra dmar rgya'am wa thod du mu z-i nag po/ lcags phye/ dngul rdo/ nyung nag sngo sna/ ser srung gzhi bdag dang bcas pa'i ming bris pa rnams bcug la/ mun par mtshams bcad nas thun gyis brab cing*/ e bhyo rma ru tse/ ghu na hrī tri/ phroṃ ghraṃ bhyo shaṃ ril su ru phroṃ/ ghrig hril ghran ta phroṃ/ gyin ta su ru/ a pa la phroṃ/

raṃ raṃ tri thun/ phroṃ nyig hril rmar stag ling shar lding bhyo/ 'ur ba phroṃ phroṃ seng 'ur/ dkar thog ling*/ dkar bran bcug /gal bun bun longs/ kā la kā la/ baṃ hril hril/ shar shar phob ya/ zhes bzlas shing rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgrub/ de nas/ āoṃ ka kha ga gha nga*/ he bhyo/ e rma ru tse/ ghū na hrī tri/ rakṣa ba sha kha rag dun tri/ tha tri du mā ra ya/ rag sha kha 'dar u thā gzir gzir yā/ lo thog sngon po drongs/ pi pi shar shar/ kha drag rtsa dmar po lang lang*/ spur ya/ dam nyams yul du raṃ raṃ/ ril ril/ phrom phrom/ king kang drag tu phob ya/ srin pho mo long*/ khyug khyug /'ur 'ur/ hril hril/ shar shar/ bhyo bhyo/ phob phob/ ces bzlas pas/ skam 'brug glog dmar sgrub khang du 'byung zhing rmi lam du rtsas ma brnga ba dang*/ gnam sa 'pho 'gyur byed pa dang*/ 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba dang*/ nyi zla lhungs pa la sogs pa 'ong ngo*/ /de nas thun dong gi thod pas nam mkha' ma mthong bar byas la/ dgra'i 'ong sa dang ri zur dang*/ yul lha'i rten yod sar thun re sbas nas/ dus gnyan la ser thun 'ong bar 'phangs/ gtor ma btang nas/ bhyo gnod sbyin chen po drag rtsal can/ /sde brgyad kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad/ /srin mo gdong mo mched bzhir bcas/ /ki kang snga ma'i las mdzad kun/ /dam nyams yul du king kang phob/ /gnod sbyin chen po zor ba'i gdong*/ /dus la bab bo sa ma ya/ /dgra bo'i lo thog drungs nas phyung*/ /thog ser sdang ba'i dgra la phob/ /'bru dang sngo rnams bcud bsdus la/ /rnal 'byor sgrub mchog bdag la stsol/ ces rbad cing dul mo brdabs pas de'i mod la 'bab nges so/ /cho 'phrul gtong ba ni/ gnod sbyin gyi gzugs spra tshil la las byas pa'i mgo la srin bya'i sgro gzug /snying khar dgra'i ling ga la/ khyim du ltas ngan sna tshogs dang*/ smyo 'bog thong zhig ces pa bris la gzhug /de wa'i thod par bcug la/

e bhyo ma ru tse/ ra rgyug sham rgyug /'phrul ting ling ka ni/ dha ma dzu ti su tri mun tri/ trai lāo kya/ sha ma bu tri/ shad shad bhyo/ ltas ngan sna tshogs dgra la thong*/ zhes bzlas pa zhag lngar bsgrubs nas/ dgra po'i grong mthong ba'i ri zur du sbas te/ sa dmar spar gang gtor la/ grong 'dir mi 'di'i khyim du song zhig /ces lam bstan pas/ 'od dang*/ me stag dang*/ rdo char dang*/ smyo 'bog dang*/ khang pa rdib pa la sogs pa yong ngo*/ babs byed na thod pa nas ling ga bton nas spos chus bkru'o/ /sri 'u gso ba ni/ ma bu'i mal gyi steng du rten gtor la/ mda' 'ug sgro ma'i mgul du gnod sbyin gyi sku dang dar leb rgan btags pa btsugs nas phul/ bstod bskul byas nas/ bu chung 'di srungs shig bya zhing*/ gnod sbyin gyi sku bris nas/ rtsa sngags bris te dril nas bu chung la btags/ rdzas bsrung la/ gla rtsi shing kun/ mu zi nag po/ za 'og /spyang brun/ bdud rtsi/ stag gi sder mo/ bya rog gi mgo /ske tshe/ brag dreg /rgya tshil/ thal chen/ shi skra/ sgog skya/ sle tres/ ba spru/ rta bon pa/ byi la'i brun rnams rta chil dang bsres la/ phye ma'i thum po lus la btags/ bu chung nyog na de rnams kyi dud pas bdug /dus bzang la gtor ma btang bas sos nges so/ /nor sgrub pa ni/ sgrub khang du maṇḍal dmar po zla gam gyi steng du/ gtor ma sgrub thabs bzhin bshams/ dar dmar la gnod sby-in gyi sku zhal gcig phyag gnyis phyed skyil can/ g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dar zab dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ padma dang bum pa'i steng na dmar gsal khro 'dzum du bzhugs pa bris pa'i rgyab tu rtsa sngags la mi nor zas gsum gyi dngos grub stsol cig bris pa'i nang du/ rdo pha wang long bu la gser ram padma raktas tri drug bris pa la/ rab gnas byas pa de dar zab kyis gril la thod pa mtshan ldan 'bru dang rin po ches bkang ba/

de'i nang du bzhag pa de dkyil 'khor gyi steng du zangs gzhong du gzhug la mchod pas mtha' bskor te/ rang nyid padma'i bsgom bzlas byas rjes/ thod pa rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du bsam pa'i nang du gnod sbyin bris pa ltar bskyed la ye shes pa bstim/ gtor ma btang*/ bstod pa byas nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ gnod sbyin gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥl phog pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mi nor longs spyod thams cad bsdus par bsam la/ e he bhyo rma ru tse/ rad na si ti (< a > siddhi ) dza/ ghu na hri hri/ rad na si ti (< a > siddhi ) hūṃ/ ghraṃ bhyo/ shaṃ rad na si ti dza hūṃ/ su ru si ti dza hūṃ/ su ru si ti (< a > siddhi ) dza/ ghrig si ti hūṃ/ ghra na ta rad na si ti (< a > siddhi ) dza/ gyin ta a tri nri si ti (< a > siddhi ) dza hūṃ/ a pa lam/ pa shaṃ ku ru si ti (< a > siddhi ) hūṃ dza/ zhes bzlas pas/ rin po che'i char babs pa dang*/ nor rnyed pa dang*/ khrom 'du ba dang*/ rnga brdung ba dang*/ /dung 'bud pa dang*/ 'bru dang longs spyod sdud pa rmi'o/ de nas/ e bhyo rma ru tse a tri nṛ dza/ si ti

(< a > siddha ) zab mo'i gdams pa bdud rtsi'i sman dang 'dra/ /nyon mongs nad rnams gso ba'i mchog yin pas/ /rgyud la brten cing legs par goms pa yis/ /da lta nyid nas klong du 'gyur bar mdzod/ /pha la rad na kha te hūṃ dza/ 'gul 'gul ma ma hring hring*/ ma ma kha shi baṃ/ a kar sha ya dza/ a kar sha ya hring*/ mi 'gram khyogs/ mi snying sgul/ nṛ srog rtsa bring bring*/ thuṃ ril/ yeṃ yeṃ/ yid kyi dbang po khug dza/ mi nor zas gsum bdag gi dbang du bsdus shig /ces pa zhag bdun bzlas pas/ 'khor dang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de nas rten gyi bla rdo de lus la gdags so/ /'du ba nyung na bla rdo brdar cing*/ me'i nang du gnod sbyin bsams te sbyin sreg bya/ gtor ma btang nas/ bhyo byang phyogs gnod sbyin gter gyi bdag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis mdzes pa'i sku/ /chibs su bya rgyal khyung la bcibs/ /sku mdog dmar po 'od zer can/ /rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras/ /phyag g.yas lcags kyus zas nor 'gugs/ /phyag g.yon ne'i les zas nor ster/ /'khor du gnod sbyin stong gis bskor/ /gter bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la/ /mchod tshogs bha ling gtor ma 'bul/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus/ /zas nor longs spyod char du phob/ /ci bsam 'grub pa'i dngos grub zhu/ /zhes rol mo dang bcas pa byas pas bsam pa 'grub bo/ /de ltar gnod sbyin dmar nag sgrub pa yi/ /rim pa gsal bar bshad des bsod nams kyis/ /ma lus re ba yid bzhin rdzogs pa'i dpal/ /yon tan 'byor ba mtha' yas yongs gang shog /gnod sbyin dmar nag gi gsang sgrub me rlung 'khyil pa zhes bya ba/ rnal 'byor pa dri med 'od zer gyis bkod pa rdzogs so// //bkra shis/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)gnod sbyin dmar nag gi sgrub pa me rlung 'khyil pa/ -PAGE 372--PAGE 371--PAGE 370-
